snippet.title: Greenrise - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Greenrise is a short and cozy incremental about chopping wood, breaking stones and mining gold. Spend what you gather on an upgrade tree, watch your island grow, then replant it and start over stronger.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4963910/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=trailer
Press kit: https://craftedbyfuchs.com/greenrise

Fully localized in 9 languages: English, Portuguese (Brazil), Spanish,
German, French, Italian, Russian, Japanese and Simplified Chinese.
